name: custom-phone-mockup
title: Phone Mockup
description: An original device frame for presenting mobile product screens with a refined shell, ambient wallpaper, and clear content area.
useWhen: An original device frame for presenting mobile product screens with a refined shell, ambient wallpaper, and clear content area.
avoidWhen: Avoid phone mockup when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Phone Mockup uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
